purpose: Three changes, all opt-in and bit-exact: (1) op profiler records COMPUTE and BARRIER separately; (2) GGML_CPU_PARALLEL_UNARY=<min_elems> lets the elementwise UNARY ops upstream pins to n_tasks=1 use all threads; (3) the same knob widens SCALE and adds a COLUMN-split path for tensors with fewer rows than threads (cache_s_l* is ne=[262144,1,1]).
note: The production libggml-cpu.so links objects from FOUR private builds plus build-goal. ops.cpp comes from rms-guard, NOT from the pool build that supplies ggml-cpu.c -- patching the wrong layer verifies self-consistently and still ships the wrong code.

verification.numerics: greedy output byte-identical on 3 prompts, knob on vs off, AND identical to production

not_implemented.mul_mat_per_op_threads: DEADLOCKS -- ggml_compute_forward_mul_mat has an internal ggml_barrier that reads the FULL team size from tp->n_graph, not params->nth.

rebuild: ./rebuild.sh [outdir] -- self-contained; no /dev/shm paths; verified to reproduce the measured library's .text byte-for-byte
applies_to: GLM-5.3-Flash ONLY. Measured no gain on DeepSeek-V4-Flash (same runtime) -- see FLEET-EXTRACTION s.38.
